sceneEncoding: Private little-endian fixture bytes, not native C/public registration ABI. Anchors are handle/x/y u16 and priority u8; columns are ridge Y/depth u16. Six candidates have handles 0..5, X=(source tick & 63)+handle, Y=20+handle, priority 3,2,1,1,0,0. Horizon/ridge Y is 40+(source tick & 3), depth is 100+column. Four fragments exercise front, clipped, hidden and above-ridge cases. Hidden bottom remains 65535; clip codes occupy two bits each. Size is 8+2*(source tick & 3), selected from the previous displayed tier. Requested view is (request tick >> VIEW_TICK_SHIFT)&1. GEOMETRY_CRC is the CRC32/ISO-HDLC of the concatenated populated byte records described by pool contract version 2. All 69 bytes are copied into the incremental backbuffer; their CRC32 is retained at swap. Candidate integration is not target qualification.
rules: All capacities and thresholds are diagnostic fixture parameters, not selected production limits or assets.

Single foreground owner; no IRQ readers. Logical commit copies the complete registration, buffer identity, view and composition together. Actual VIC publication remains a separate integration obligation.
An attempt binds generation, source snapshot tick, view, tier, buffer and horizon once. View requests do not mutate a bound attempt or displayed generation.
Only complete-buffer plus matching registration may become ready. A ready generation for a superseded requested view cannot swap.

Anchors rank by priority ascending, then stable handle ascending; selected/essential cues use priority 0, decorative cues 3. Overflow discards the lowest-ranked anchor and is counted; duplicate retained handles reject.

Occlusion columns belong to the bound generation. Screen Y increases downward; a greater unsigned depth is behind terrain. Behind fragments at or below ridge Y are hidden or clipped. This is presentation-only integer geometry, not terrain query/contact data.

Tier 0 is the cheap fixture and tier 1 the detailed fixture. Enter at or above LOD_ENTER_PIXELS; leave at or below LOD_EXIT_PIXELS; retain the previous choice in between. Selection occurs before bind, never during resume.

Invalid identity, missing envelope columns, premature swap and counter overflow reject without publication. Cancel abandons only the private unfinished/ready attempt; the displayed generation is retained.
nonClaims: target link, memory-fit or timing evidence
VIC-IV atomic publication or physical evidence
